name: Develop a fundraising campaign
description: Design a fundraising campaign, assess the project's possible impact and check credibility.
input:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA – entirely fictional, for trying things out only.

Organisation: Reading Friends Exampletown (fictional charity), 60 volunteers, one part-time employee
Project: "Reading buddies at primary schools" – volunteers read weekly for a school year with children who need
support with reading.
So far: 2025/26 at 4 schools with 48 children. Teachers' feedback: 31 of 48 children read more fluently
(an assessment, not a standardised measurement).
Goal: expansion to 8 schools and 100 children in the 2026/27 school year
Funding need: EUR 25,000 (coordination EUR 15,000, books and materials EUR 6,000, training EUR 4,000)
Campaign period: 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30
Existing channels: newsletter (1,200 recipients), Instagram (900 followers), good contacts with the local paper

guide.problem: Fundraising campaigns need a moving story, but also honest statements about impact. The workflow develops a campaign, assesses the possible impact and checks whether promises are credible and ethically sound.
guide.flow: The campaign developer and the impact analyst work in parallel: one designs message, target groups and measures, the other builds an impact model with indicators and calculates the cost per child with the calculator tool. The credibility reviewer checks both; the result contains all three parts.
guide.input: Organisation, project, results so far, goal, funding need, campaign period and existing channels.
guide.result: A campaign concept with timeline and draft texts, an impact model with indicators and a structured review for exaggerated claims, ethical notes and a plan for measuring impact, also as a Word file. The impact analyst proposes its impact model for knowledge, for example for later funding applications; only what you confirm is stored.
guide.adapt: Describe your project and your results as honestly as possible. Upload annual reports or evaluations as knowledge and assign them to the impact analyst.

campaign.name: Campaign developer
campaign.description: Designs the message, target groups, channels and schedule of the campaign.
campaign.system: You are a fundraising expert for non-profit organisations. Develop a fundraising campaign: core message, target groups, giving prompts such as "With 50 euros …", channels, a schedule over the campaign period and three draft texts (newsletter, social media, press release). Tell the story respectfully and without pity imagery, and use only results stated in the description.

impact.name: Impact analyst
impact.description: Builds an impact model with indicators and the cost per child.
impact.system: You are an impact analyst for social projects. Build an impact model (inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes, impact), propose measurable indicators with a collection method and use the calculator tool to calculate the cost per child and per cost block. Assess honestly what the results so far prove and what they do not.

integrity.name: Credibility reviewer
integrity.description: Checks statements for exaggeration, ethics and evidence.
integrity.system: You check fundraising material for credibility and ethics. Compare the campaign's statements with the impact model: what is proven, what is overstated, what should be phrased more cautiously? Pay attention to the dignity of the people shown, data protection for photos of children and transparency about the use of funds. Propose a simple plan for measuring impact.

fields.credible: Is the campaign credible in its current form?
fields.overstated_claims: Overstated or unsupported statements with better wording
